After initial purchase I've bought all sizes- excellent product! The design of the lids is excellent, and everything can be put through the dishwasher. They keep all kinds of food MUCH fresher: crackers, nuts, oats, rice, cereal, lentils, brownie bites, candy and also olives, capers, mushrooms, limes, tangerines, baby carrots, leftover cut veggies, cherry tomatoes and also herbs -- I was amazed how long parsley and cilantro lasted in these jars! The oranges and limes stayed fresh and juicy for over a month. Just be careful your house mates don't take them for personal care and work shop, they are also great for nails, screws, lipstick, cotton balls, and much else.In my opinion, very impressed with the quality. Glass is not thin or fragile. Some individuals felt difficulties with when screwing lid. I myself, fine they create a nice seal. I can see if you have arthritic hands, it might be a little challenging to unscrew them. A workaround, don’t cinch the lid down tightly. Other than that, I would definitely buy again.These are very durable, enough space to fit fruit or food into. If you’re going to meal prep I would highly recommend using these, they are very convenient if you just want to pop in the microwave after a workout or just on a regular day. reviews_1s:
These REEK of chemicals. I've never encountered glass that smells like this, because glass shouldn't smell like this. Even after 3 washes, still chemicals. I honestly have half a mind to report this seller because again, glass shouldn't ever smell this way. Amazon has quickly become a temu or shein - anytime I order something by a brand I don't know, it turns out to be toxic chinese crap that ends up being thrown away, which is exactly what's going to happen with these jars since I'm mortified to put anything I later plan on consuming in them.I purchased the Netany 6-pack of 16 oz glass jars hoping for a good, reusable storage solution. Unfortunately, my experience was incredibly frustrating. The biggest issue is the lids. They simply do not fit properly. Many of the jars struggled to seal, rendering them essentially useless for preserving food or storing anything that needs to be airtight. This is a fundamental flaw that renders the product practically worthless.

Beyond the ill-fitting lids, the jars themselves are excessively slippery when wet, making them difficult and even dangerous to handle. Several near-misses with dropping jars convinced me to reach for alternatives.

Overall, this product is a major disappointment. The combination of poorly fitting lids and slippery glass makes them a risky and impractical choice. I strongly advise against purchasing these jars. Save your money and look for a more reliable brand that prioritizes quality control. This product deserves its one-star rating.What a waste of money!
